findings.title: Primary queue handoff accepts unknown/incomplete state and unrelated COMPLETE stage
findings.explanation: The handoff guard uses not queue.get(active) and a suffix-only stage check. Missing active, null or boolfalse are accepted as evidence of no original workers, and any unrelated stage ending_COMPLETE satisfies the terminal-state condition. The independently pinned original stage receipt and genuine phase/native leases are important separate gates, but do not make an unknown current queue record an affirmative original-primary terminal observation.
findings.reproduction: Temporary D fixture and synthetic code-bound bridge/stage artifacts with exact30 canonical H run IDs/declared210roles: _bridge_gate(full=True) returns successfully for H_queue_status values {stage:UNRELATED_COMPLETE}, {stage:UNRELATED_COMPLETE,active:null}, and {stage:UNRELATED_COMPLETE,active:false}. No lease or GPU was acquired.
findings.impact: The new owner can pass the worker eligibility gate without an explicit empty active list or the actual original H primary cache completion stage. This weakens the stated fail-closed original-stage handoff requirement.
findings.requested_change: Require the exact known original primary cache terminal stage and an explicitly present typed empty active list; validate/bind expected primary-owner/status provenance from the approved handoff evidence as appropriate. Reject missing/null/bool active values and unrelated COMPLETE stages. Add negative regressions and a valid canonical terminal-state positive case.
